items.headline: Oklahoma AD rips Ole Miss, SEC; Rebels defend travel effort
items.description: Oklahoma AD Roger Denny ripped the SEC and Ole Miss for the "inexplicable" decision to move its game to Sunday, while the Rebels defended their travel efforts.
